# The person's answers in the resources proxy run

The person plays Ada Example (fictional), whose site is the sample site with
the default design. Their first message does not name the module. One link
starts with http:// and must be written with https://.

- First message: Hi, can I add something more to my site?
- Which module: Resources
- Links: MDN Web Docs, https://developer.mozilla.org/, where I look up every HTML element and CSS property. web.dev, https://web.dev/, for performance and accessibility guides. The A11Y Project, http://www.a11yproject.com/, because its checklist got me started with accessibility.
- Read-back: Great, that's all.
